title: Obadiah 1: chapter overview
paragraphs: Destruction to come upon Edom. Their offences against Jacob.
The restoration of the Jews, and their flourishing state in the latter times.

outline.text: Destruction to come upon Edom. Their offences against Jacob.
The restoration of the Jews, and their flourishing state in the latter times.

context: The first part denounces the destruction of Edom, dwelling upon the injuries they inflicted upon the Jews.
attribution: Matthew Henry, Concise Commentary (public domain). Historical Protestant interpretation; other traditions may read these passages differently.
